test_title: PYST 50: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: In a village election, Sharuk got 80% of the total valid votes. 10% of the votes were invalid. If the total number of votes was 4500, then find the number of valid votes the other candidate got.
solution:
**Given:**

Sharuk got 80% of the total valid votes.

10% of the votes were invalid.

The total number of votes was 4500

**Calculation:**

 Valid Votes = 4500 × 90 % = 4500 × (90)/(100) =4050

And Invalid Votes = 4500 × 10 % = 4500 × (10)/(100) =450

Out of Valid Votes Sharuk got 80% of the total valid votes and 20% votes other candidate got.

⇒ Sharuk got Votes = 4050 × (80)/(100) = 3240

⇒ Other Candidate Got = 4050 × (20)/(100) = 810

**∴ Valid number of votes are 810.**
